title: Second-order Poincaré inequalities and localization on the Poisson space
summary: Given a mean zero functional $F$ of a Poisson measure on a metric space, we apply the Malliavin-Stein method to establish sharpened second-order Poincaré inequalities for $F/\sqrt{\operatorname{Var} (F)}$ in terms of fourth moments of difference operators. The rates of normal approximation are expressed in the Kolmogorov and Wasserstein distances and require fewer error terms than corresponding previous results.
